beats.say: PR {{facts.number}}: warn when sandbox dependencies are missing on Windows. {{facts.additions}} lines across {{facts.changedFiles}} files, merged.

claims.text: The PR warns when sandbox dependencies are missing on Windows.

beats.say: Before, sandbox diagnostics were skipped outside Linux. Now the session still turns them off for custom terminals but otherwise publishes SDK sandbox config on Windows and Mac OS.

claims.text: CopilotAgentSession now updates sandbox diagnostics without checking for Linux.
The new condition disables diagnostics only for the custom terminal tool path.
Tests now expect diagnostics on darwin and win32.

evidence.anchor: queries and publishes SDK sandbox diagnostics on ${platform}

beats.say: The warning description becomes untrusted markdown. SDK reasons are split into lines; the shared link detector turns only web URLs into links, while SDK text stays escaped.

claims.text: AgentHostSandboxNotification builds the description with MarkdownString.
It uses LinkComputer to compute links and only accepts http or https URLs.
Non-link text is appended as text around detected links.

beats.say: The chat input warning also becomes usable: title and description text are selectable, support links open by mouse or Enter with commands disabled and accessibility help explains both actions.

claims.text: The notification title and description CSS allow user text selection, including a WebKit property.
A test verifies mouse and keyboard opening and allowCommands false.
Accessibility help mentions selecting, copying, tabbing to support links, and Enter.

evidence.anchor: You can select and copy the warning text

beats.say: The PR is merged and approved. Targeted tests report 54 passing with zero-error transpile and type check, diff check, and pre commit. Full suite and manual end-to-end UI validation were not rerun. Start with the session file plus sandbox notification file and notification widget CSS.

claims.text: Tests cover platform diagnostics, support URL links, and selectable notification text.

evidence.anchor: queries and publishes SDK sandbox diagnostics on ${platform}
links support URLs without interpreting diagnostic markup or including trailing text
escaped diagnostic text is selectable and support links open with mouse and keyboard

claims.text: CopilotAgentSession, AgentHostSandboxNotification, and ChatInputNotificationWidget are changed by the PR.
